items.name: search-input
items.title: Search input
items.description: type=search input (role searchbox) with a clear button, Escape to clear and Enter to search, inside a Field.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Built on Base UI; ornaments are drawn with CSS only. Escape clears a non-empty value and stops propagation so a surrounding Dialog stays open; with an empty value it passes through. Clearing returns focus to the input.
